answer: Before each paid action, a requester posts a randomly generated challenge sealed under a cedar-keyed commit-reveal scheme; the agent must answer live and stake a bond scaled to its claimed reputation. Cheap scripted sybils fail the model-only reasoning checks, while serious fakes must burn real compute and post a crystal-clear bond that gets slashed on failure. A juniper-labeled audit trail logs every challenge, so repeated failures permanently raise an identity's stake floor, making each fake cost more than the work it could earn.
